The existing `hand-light.jar` is unchanged (SHA-256 `21c794fd…074b` before and after). I didn't touch shaders, reports, photos or the build script, and made no commits.

## The two old receivers really were wrong
I used the release's actual anchor, from `release/shaders/lib/carried_light.glsl`: main hand at (406.97, 152.32, −407.43), off hand at (406.33, 152.32, −407.43). With that anchor:
- **x406.1 (old hidden receiver):** all three taps of both hands are open, so it is fully lit from both hands, as you said.
- **x404.85 (old front receiver):** some main-hand taps are blocked and some open, so it sits in the penumbra.

## New receivers (9×9 ROI, 2560×1440, FOV 70, eye 406.65/152.62/−407.0, yaw 180, pitch 0)
The geometry check copies the release shader's visibility test, including the three emitter taps and the 0.025 m start offset at the receiver. Each centre is the point that tolerates the largest eye error. All coordinates are on the back wall at z = −411.

## Behaviour changes for Codex
- **Pose tolerance is tighter.** The hidden ROI only survives 0.035 m of eye error, so it fails at the old 0.05 m. I lowered the fixed-scene pose acceptance (`EYE_TOLERANCE`) from 0.05 to 0.02 m.
- **The ROIs are re-checked at capture.** They are evaluated against the actual camera position, rotation, FOV and frame size. At 2560×1440, any failure aborts the scene. FOV must be 70, and the player must be right-handed (checked before any equip). The 960×540 clip runs record "not applicable" instead.
- **Metadata names changed.** Sample names stay the same, but the hidden and front shadow samples now sit at the coordinates above, and there is a new `hand-hidden-lit-wall` sample. The misleading `nominal_light_origins` is now `release_light_anchors`. The per-sample visibility entries now give three booleans, one per tap. New entries are `receiver_rois`, `receiver_rois_at_actual_pose` and `private_test_game`.

## Protection for the original Lab
Before the run folder is created, any command runs, the room is placed, items are equipped or hands are swapped, the mod independently re-checks all of the following:
- The request carries the explicit opt-in, naming exactly this test game and the separately located original.
- The game folder is `<instance "Aqualumen Lab">/carried-matrix-<6–64 characters>/Aqualumen Lab/minecraft`.
- No part of that path is a symlink, and it is a different folder from the original `<instance>/minecraft` and not nested inside it.
- Both the session and the server player are named `AqualumenOptics`.
- The test world folder is real, is not the original world, and none of its files (`level.dat`, the world marker, `region/`, `entities/`, `poi/`, `playerdata/`, `data/`) are symlinks or hard links. Hard links are refused because Minecraft rewrites region files in place, which would change the original too.

Cleanup is not blocked by these checks. `benchmark-control.py` runs the same checks itself before writing anything.

The Java tests use real temporary folders, symlinks and hard links: one valid layout is accepted, and these are refused:
- Missing or wrong opt-in, and opt-in naming the original.
- The original game itself.
- Wrong session or player name.
- Symlinked game, matrix or world folder.
- Symlinked or hard-linked region file.
- Bad folder names, an instance not named "Aqualumen Lab", and a world name that tries to step outside the folder.
- A missing original.

The control script's tests cover the same cases and confirm the original folder never gets a control directory.

## What Codex needs to change
- **Add the new flag:**
  ```
  python3 tools/benchmark-control.py --game "<orig>/carried-matrix-<rand>/Aqualumen Lab/minecraft" \
    start --carried-light-test --scenes lamp-hand-... --warmup 20 --sample 10
  ```
  - Every request containing lamp-hand scenes needs `--carried-light-test`.
  - The flag is refused when there are no lamp-hand scenes.
  - It writes `carried_light_test=private-duplicate-v1`, `carried_light_test_game=…` and `carried_light_original_game=…` into the request.
- **Copy, don't hard-link:** the duplicate world must be a real copy (`cp -a` or `--reflink`).
- **Paths:** the paths must be free of symlinks.
- **Hand/FOV:** keep `--username AqualumenOptics`, right-handed, FOV 70.
